hook: Sensex slid 500 points to 82,032 as profit booking hit after nine-month highs

mood.basis: proxy: 0.35 x S&P 500 + 0.15 x avg(Nikkei, Kospi)

stories.title: Sensex falls 500 points to 82,032, Nifty down 159 at 25,228 on profit booking
stories.summary: Profit booking after nine-month highs, with weakness in metal and jewellery stocks, led broad-based selling. Midcaps fell over 1%.
stories.why: A pause after a nine-month high shows how stretched the rally had become for Indian equities.

stories.title: Public sector banks' business crosses ₹300 lakh crore for first time; H1 profit up 16.9%
stories.summary: PSB profit rose 16.9% to ₹1.10 lakh crore in H1FY27. Advances grew 18.8% against deposit growth of 13.1%, and gross NPA fell to 1.69%.
stories.why: Faster loan growth and cleaner books point to a healthy credit cycle for Indian banks.

stories.title: India imposes duty on bulk Scotch imports, above the 150% that applied before the UK FTA
stories.summary: The effective levy is higher than the 150% duty before the India-UK trade pact, which had halved the tariff to 75% in July. United Spirits, Radico Khaitan and Allied Blenders are in focus.
stories.why: Higher import duty changes the competitive picture for domestic liquor makers.

stories.title: Gold rises 0.6% from a 14-month low as markets weigh a 90% chance of a Fed hike
stories.summary: Experts see a 90% probability of a 25-basis-point US rate increase in December. The Bank of Japan is preparing its third rate hike this year.
stories.why: Gold moves drive sentiment in Indian gold lenders.

stories.title: Infosys to invest JPY 1.59 billion for 10.1% stake in NTT Docomo Playspace
stories.summary: Infosys will be strategic technology and AI partner for the Japan-based joint venture, focused on metaverse experiences and digital twins.
stories.why: Shows Indian IT firms pushing into AI-led services in Japan.

stories.title: Prestige buys 50% stake in Advent Convention and Hotels for Rs 500 crore
stories.summary: The partnership will develop a commercial project in Andheri, Mumbai, with 1.50 million square feet of leasable space. Project value is put near Rs 4,500 crore.
stories.why: Adds commercial space to Prestige's Mumbai pipeline.

stories.title: Dalmia Bharat to consider share buyback at November 23 board meeting
stories.summary: Size, price and shares have not been disclosed. The company also plans to expand capacity to 75 million tonnes per annum by FY28.
stories.why: A buyback signals confidence in cash flows from the cement business.

stories.title: Jio Financial and BlackRock invest ₹123 crore each in Jio BlackRock Asset Management
stories.summary: The rights issue raises ₹246 crore in total for the 50:50 joint venture to fund its business operations.
stories.why: Fresh capital supports the asset management venture of Jio Financial.

stories.title: Bharat Forge puts ₹291 crore into Kalyani Strategic Systems via rights issue
stories.summary: The 29.05 crore equity shares of ₹10 each were funded from QIP proceeds, into the wholly owned subsidiary.
stories.why: Signals Bharat Forge is backing its defence arm with fresh capital.
